entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Right now. I have my order number ready.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just to understand the situation, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?

Look, it doesn't matter. I don't want it. I got it for Christmas and it's not what I needed. Let's not waste time with twenty questions. Are you going to process the return or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand. My apologies, I just need to follow the process. Could I please have the order number to pull up your account?

It's VF-8675309. And let me just stop you right there. I know I've had it for a few weeks, and I don't want to hear some ridiculous new company policy about 'hygiene' or 'sanitation' risks. That's garbage. It's barely been used.
Okay, I have the order pulled up now. Just one moment while I review the details...

I'm a VIP member, I spend thousands here. If you tell me it's 'too late' to return this, I'm filing a chargeback and you can bet I'll be posting this entire transcript on every social media platform. Your choice.
Sir, I appreciate your patience. I've reviewed your account and the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I see it was delivered on December 15th.
Yeah, and? Get to the part where you deny me.

Actually, there's no denial necessary. Our return policy for this item is 10 days from the date of delivery. You're unfortunately outside the timeframe, so it's definitely not too late. I can process this return for you immediately.
...What? You can? I thought with anything wearable it was a much shorter window.

I can see why you might think that, as some specific electronics have different terms. But for this device, our standard 10-day policy applies. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You should see it in the next five minutes.
Oh. Well. Okay then. That was... much easier than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. As a valued VIP member, we always want to make sure you're taken care of. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. I'll look for the email. Thanks, Isaac.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
